title_en: Jobs (16/20): A Flight Attendant in the Cabin
note_en: 让 is the go-to verb for "make / let someone do something": 让他感觉舒服一些 "to make him feel a little more comfortable," and 这让我觉得这份工作很有价值 "this made me feel the job is worthwhile." The pattern is always 让 + person + verb phrase, with no word like "to" in between, and the subject can even be a situation (这) rather than a person.
